breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the thin-walled tube approximation (shear flow relation q = T/(2Am), τ = q/t) instead of removing it entirely. The ground truth uses only the exact thick-walled torsion formula with J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32. The agent added the exact method but kept the thin-walled method as well, asking to compare both approaches, which still perpetuates the original error of using the thin-walled approximation.
